jobs.name: moore-ins-paul-3
jobs.prompt: This is a history documentary about the May 3, 1999 Oklahoma tornado outbreak. @char1 sits at his desk and speaks straight to the camera. One full-width 16:9 shot of a single man in a quiet study, never a split image, a collage or panels. Medium shot, the camera does not move. Calm, deep, measured voice, natural small hand movement. He says exactly these words and nothing else: "Minutes after the tornado tore through Bridge Creek, a forecaster in Norman typed two words no warning had ever carried." He stops speaking and holds his look at the camera. No music, no captions, no text on screen.
